contexts.text: That he wants to investigate the things of faith. Signified, Explained.
They who pervert... the truths of faith by wanting to investigate them by means of knowledges and reasonings. Signified.
A drunkard = those who want to investigate spiritual and celestial things from scientifics.
That he had deprived himself of the truths of faith by wanting to investigate them by sensuous things...
Investigation of what its quality was. Signified, Explained.
They who investigated these correspondences were called by them wise ones.
To dig... in the Original Language, when it is applied to truths, means to investigate.
The investigation of the doctrine of truth Divine. Signified.
They who investigate causes... and are called Intelligences. CL 461:6. TCR 570:3.
By the investigation () is signified the salvation which is the end.

This is the reason why no one in the natural or Spiritual World is allowed to investigate the spiritual sense of the Word from the sense of its letter, unless he is completely in the doctrine of Divine truth, and in illustration from the Lord...
